proved_conditional_statement.conclusion: For every original leaf v, Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v])<=0. Consequently the sum over any fixed subset of original leaves is nonpositive.
hypotheses: for every first-mark block with d>=3, p-2>=K(d)=2m(d)-d

marked_shadow_identity: q_j(H,W)=sum_i i_(j-1)(J_i), where marks are ordered with nonisolated marks first and J_i=H-(N_H[w_i] union earlier marks).
cover_loss: For ell_i=|V(H)\V(J_i)|>=2, tau(J_i)>=tau(H)-(ell_i-1). Proof: a vertex cover of J_i together with deleted vertices other than w_i covers H.

boundary_cases.handling: Ordinary shadow: |J|<=2r+1 gives i_(r+1)<=i_r by double count.
m=K=2; exact first-wide two-edge result covers r=1, generic matching result covers r>=2.
Requires both the large-rank matching threshold and r>=K(d).

catalan_cutoff.conclusion: The cover-Catalan lower bound cannot force tau(T)>=9 at this rank; this is a method failure, not a counterexample to the shell claim.

small_rank_residual.meaning: Low-cover six-cover cases are not handled by the uniform tau>=7 exclusion; a complete skeleton proof is needed before finite enumeration.

scope_warning: No unconditional shell theorem or primary aggregate result is established when the parent cover threshold fails.
